events.label: Torque spike
events.description: Erratic torque up to 35 kNm at 1162.4 m in Namsang.
events.cause: Bit balling in sticky clay.
events.action_taken: Reduced RPM to 100 and WOB to 9 t, pumped a detergent sweep.
events.lesson: Use a PDC bit with anti-balling nozzles and control ROP in Namsang.

events.label: Stuck pipe
events.description: Pipe stuck at 1665.0 m while pulling out in Girujan Clay; overpull 26 t.
events.cause: Swelling clay closing the hole (reactive Girujan Clay).
events.action_taken: Jarred down 40 times, spotted a pipe-freeing pill. Pipe free after 22.1 hrs.
events.lesson: Use KCl-polymer mud (7 % KCl) and back-ream every stand through Girujan Clay.

events.label: Stuck pipe

events.label: Mud loss
events.description: Partial losses of 31 bbl/hr while drilling at 2237.2 m in Tipam Sandstone.
events.cause: Weak, partly depleted Tipam Sandstone sands; ECD of 10.6 ppg above the fracture gradient.
events.action_taken: Cut flow rate by 20 %, pumped 56 bbl LCM pill (CaCO3 medium + fibre). Losses cured after 17.7 hrs.
events.lesson: Pre-treat the mud with 15-20 ppb LCM from 50 m above the Tipam Sandstone top and keep ECD below 10.3 ppg.

events.label: Non-productive time
